savedReplies.question: How can you help me related to my dog?
savedReplies.answer: I can help with general dog-care education, daily routines, grooming, calm handling, enrichment, and organizing caregiver notes into factual summaries or vet-visit questions. I don’t have selected observations here, so I can’t make dog-specific claims. I won’t diagnose, triage, choose medication or doses, or recommend treatment; health concerns should go to a veterinarian.
